arms.name: random_all_ema
arms.purpose: conservative allocation control receives one additional step and greater cost

execution.forward: ordinary dense attention projections, attention matmuls, and FFN for every token
execution.mask_resolution: current pre-FFN low_max_abs or random mask is resolved after dense attention forward and before backward; no planning pre-pass
execution.backward: gathered active-row-only Q/K/V/O projection and FFN dgrad/wgrad; dense attention-score backward; inactive projection-path input gradients zero; residual paths intact
execution.ema: identical final 0.95 EMA for every arm, with no decay sweep or intermediate checkpoint selection
execution.deployment: ordinary dense inference with averaged weights

cost_accounting.auxiliary_operations: realized scoring, FFN and attention gather/scatter estimates, and two EMA operations per parameter per step included
cost_accounting.evaluation: reported separately and excluded from training-plus-EMA cost

primary_endpoint: final EMA ordinary dense held-out loss at training-plus-EMA cost

decision_rules.allocation_failure: low_max_abs all-projection EMA does not beat random despite random receiving more steps and cost; stop
decision_rules.no_level_3: low_max_abs beats random but not dense EMA, or its total cost exceeds dense; stop
decision_rules.development_level_3: low_max_abs EMA loss is below random and dense EMA while its total cost is no greater than either
decision_rules.confirmation: only development_level_3 launches the identical body-7 comparison

prohibited: a second dense planning forward pass
computing dense projection backward and merely masking its gradients
sweeping EMA decay or activity after launch
excluding attention gather/scatter or EMA costs
launching body 7 without a development-level win
